text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City Policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to install all-way stop control at the intersection of Richmond Street West and Niagara Street to enhance safety for pedestrians, cyclists and motorists at this intersection. The installation of the all-way stop sign control is technically warranted and will enhance operational safety at this intersection.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized all-way stop control at the intersection of Richmond Street West and Niagara Street (north intersection).
